content: 1 To the chiefe musition vpon Neginoth, a wyse instruction of Dauid, when the Ziphims came and sayd vnto Saul, hath not Dauid hyd him selfe amongst vs? Saue me O Lorde for thy name sake: iudge me accordyng to thy mightie power. 2 Heare my prayer O Lord: and hearken vnto the wordes of my mouth. 3 For straungers are rysen vp against me: and tirauntes whiche haue not the Lorde before their eyes, seeke after my soule. Selah. 4 Behold, God is an ayde vnto me: the Lorde is with them that vpholde my soule. 5 He wyll rewarde euyll vnto mine enemies: destroy thou them according to thy trueth. 6 I wyll sacrifice vnto thee with a true wyllyng heart: I wyll confesse thy name O God, because it is good. 7 For he hath deliuered me out of all my trouble: and mine eye hath seene auengaunce vpon mine enemies.
